Card Q&A.q: If I have exactly 3 cards in my security stack, do I activate both the "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect and the "gain 1 memory" effect when activating this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] If you have 3 or more security cards, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. If you have 3 or fewer, gain 1 memory.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] While this Digimon has [Pulsemon] in its text, it gets +1000 DP.
